The '''''segade'' plant''' is a type of flora from the [[Aiel Waste]].

==Description==
The ''segade'' plant is a fat leafless plant with a leathery skin, spines and white blossoms.

==References==
According to the [[Aiel]], a woman who makes a [[bridal wreath]] with ''segade'' blossoms indicates that she has a prickly nature and means to keep it.{{ref/book|5|21}} [[Rand al'Thor]] sent ''segade'' flowers to [[Aviendha]], unaware of their significance.

==Parallels==
Judging by the description of the plant, a ''segade'' seems to be a {{Wiki|cactus}}.
